numerical-reports/static-background-repe.limitations: Post-matrix diagnostic repeat, not an extra independent seed or replacement for original outcomes. Each training in fresh subprocess, TF32 off; no CUDA context in comparison parent.

numerical-reports/static-background-equi.limitations: No training/optimizer update or timing claim. Same saved float32 weights and coordinates cast to each dtype. model_step and actual backward policy used. Collocation reconstructed from saved config/seed, not recovered from original training snapshots. Symmetric warmup, self-repeat checks, independent backgrounds. FP64 evaluation is not FP64 training; it cannot establish the exact cause of historical CUDA optimizer divergence.

numerical-reports/static-background-boun.limitations: Finite independent face-interior samples including initial/final times, physical AD, no analytical teacher. No operator aggregation across heterogeneous fields/units. Post-study diagnostic not part of measured training.

heat_neumann_polynomial2d.limitations: Only L-BFGS snapshots after completed Adam. Two adjacent successes required; no interpolation. Previous snapshot I/O included and reported separately. Analytical evaluation follows all optimizer steps, never changes training. Quality uses independent eager physical autograd. Prediction timing of the trained executor and eager control are separate. Shared-process reuse is diagnostic and may affect FP32 repeatability.
